Metrics & Monitoring

1. Overview
  • Ignite exposes metrics for caches, compute, memory, persistence, and cluster health;
  • Metrics can be accessed programmatically, via JMX, or exported to external monitoring systems;
2. Cache Metrics
  • Enable per cache: 
    CacheConfiguration cfg = new CacheConfiguration("myCache");
cfg.setStatisticsEnabled(true);
  • Query cache metrics: 
    CacheMetrics metrics = cache.metrics();

long gets = metrics.getCacheGets();
long puts = metrics.getCachePuts();
long hits = metrics.getCacheHits();
long misses = metrics.getCacheMisses();
float hitRate = metrics.getCacheHitPercentage();
long size = metrics.getCacheSize();
3. Cluster Metrics
  • ClusterMetrics clusterMetrics = ignite.cluster().metrics();

int totalNodes = clusterMetrics.getTotalNodes();
long heapUsed = clusterMetrics.getHeapMemoryUsed();
long heapMax = clusterMetrics.getHeapMemoryMaximum();
double cpuLoad = clusterMetrics.getCurrentCpuLoad();
int activeJobs = clusterMetrics.getCurrentActiveJobs();
4. Data Region Metrics
  • Enable data region metrics to monitor memory usage: 
    DataRegionConfiguration regionCfg = new DataRegionConfiguration();
regionCfg.setMetricsEnabled(true);

// Query at runtime
DataRegionMetrics drm = ignite.dataRegionMetrics("Default_Region");
long allocatedPages = drm.getTotalAllocatedPages();
float fillFactor = drm.getPagesFillFactor();
5. JMX Monitoring
  • Ignite exposes all metrics via JMX MBeans;
  • Connect with JConsole, VisualVM, or any JMX-compatible monitoring tool;
  • MBeans are organized under the org.apache.ignite domain;
  • Key MBean groups: Caches, Data Regions, Thread Pools, Transactions, Discovery;
6. Integration with External Monitoring
  • Prometheus + Grafana — use a JMX exporter to expose Ignite metrics to Prometheus;
  • OpenCensus — Ignite has an OpenCensus metrics exporter module;
  • GridGain Control Center — a commercial tool for monitoring Ignite clusters;
  • Example JMX exporter setup: 
    # Add JMX exporter as a JVM agent
export JVM_OPTS="$JVM_OPTS -javaagent:jmx_prometheus_javaagent.jar=9090:config.yaml"
